headline: Mexico's FEMSA Posts 81% Surge in Q3 Net Income to $567 Million
summary: FEMSA's third-quarter net income climbed 81% to approximately $567 million, aided by returning OXXO store foot traffic, currency gains, and favorable comparisons to last year's net loss.
why: FEMSA is Latin America's largest convenience store operator and beverage distributor, serving as a bellwether for Mexican consumer spending.

impacts.name: Fomento Economico Mexicano SAB
impacts.why: Net income rose 81% on strong retail footfall at OXXO and foreign exchange gains.
